title: Cloud CLI caches and regenerable state under $HOME
notes: Deploy/platform CLIs, K8s client caches, IaC plugin caches. Prefer contents-only + age gates. NEVER delete long-lived credentials: $HOME/.aws/credentials, $HOME/.aws/config, azureProfile.json / MSAL / TokenCache under .azure, gcloud application_default_credentials / credentials.db / access_tokens.db, kubeconfig, vercel/netlify/render auth.json. sops and age are out of scope (secrets tooling). aws-vault is report-only. Engine never-touch currently prefixes entire $HOME/.aws and $HOME/.config/gcloud; AWS CLI cache paths below are still catalogued for reclaim when safety allowlists narrow to credentials files only. Deeper expansions beyond batch-03: terraform providers/checkpoint, pulumi policies/templates, helm registry, kubectl discovery/http subdirs, krew index/store.

rules.name: AWS CLI temporary credential cache
rules.description: Regenerable STS assume-role / process-credential JSON under cli/cache. Not long-lived access keys.
rules.notes: Contains short-lived AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey/SessionToken JSON from assume-role. Re-fetched on next CLI use. NEVER $HOME/.aws/credentials or config. Runtime never-touch may still prefix-block entire .aws until safety is refined.

rules.name: AWS SSO and login token caches (report-only)
rules.description: SSO and aws login on-disk token caches; report size only, do not auto-delete.
rules.notes: Session/token material. Clearing forces re-auth (aws sso login / aws login). Inventory only. Never credentials or config files.

rules.name: saml2aws credential cache (report-only)
rules.description: saml2aws profile cache under .aws/saml2aws (and optional custom credentials-file).
rules.notes: SAML assertion / temp AWS creds cache. Report-only; clearing forces re-login. Do not treat as generic junk.

rules.name: aws-vault sessions and file backend (report-only)
rules.description: aws-vault encrypted credential store and session metadata. Keychain backend has no bulk path wipe.
rules.notes: Default macOS backend is Keychain (not a disk cache). File backend uses AWS_VAULT_FILE_DIR (~/.awsvault). Sessions are sensitive; report-only only. Prefer aws-vault clear / keychain UI.

rules.name: Azure CLI logs
rules.description: Azure CLI log_dir default under ~/.azure/logs (command logs, not tokens).
rules.notes: Default logging.enable_log_file writes under AZURE_CONFIG_DIR/logs. commands/ holds command inventory cache. Never azureProfile.json, config, clouds.config, TokenCache.dat, msal_token_cache*, accessTokens.json.

rules.name: Azure CLI telemetry and version-check junk
rules.description: Telemetry events and version check artifacts under ~/.azure.
rules.notes: Regenerable CLI housekeeping. Prefer az cache purge for object cache; do not wipe whole ~/.azure.

rules.name: Azure CLI installed extensions
rules.description: Dynamically installed az extensions under cliextensions (reinstallable).
rules.notes: az extension add re-downloads. Medium due to reinstall cost and offline use.

rules.name: Azure CLI MSAL HTTP cache (not token cache)
rules.description: MSAL HTTP response cache files (not msal_token_cache credentials).
rules.notes: HTTP layer cache only. Explicitly exclude msal_token_cache.json/bin and TokenCache.dat (auth).

rules.name: gcloud CLI user cache
rules.description: gcloud / Cloud SDK cache under XDG/Library cache roots (not CLOUDSDK_CONFIG secrets).
rules.notes: Never delete $HOME/.config/gcloud credentials.db, application_default_credentials.json, access_tokens.db, or configurations/. Engine never-touch covers .config/gcloud tree.

rules.name: gcloud CLI logs under config dir (report-only)
rules.description: gcloud file logs live under CLOUDSDK_CONFIG/logs (default ~/.config/gcloud/logs).
rules.notes: Logs are regenerable (max_log_days default 30) but path sits under never-touch .config/gcloud. Prefer gcloud config set core/disable_file_logging or native log GC. Report size only unless safety allowlists logs subpath.

rules.name: doctl DigitalOcean CLI cache and support dirs
rules.description: doctl cache/support paths on macOS (config with tokens stays report-only).
rules.notes: Config/token default is ~/Library/Application Support/doctl/config.yaml (do not delete). Caches only here.

rules.name: doctl config directory (report-only)
rules.description: doctl auth/config store; inventory only.
rules.notes: Contains API tokens. Never auto-clean.

rules.name: flyctl agent logs and cache state
rules.description: Fly.io flyctl agent logs and regenerable state under ~/.fly (not auth config).
rules.notes: Keep ~/.fly/config.yml and tokens. ~/.fly/bin is installed binary tree (separate medium rule).

rules.name: flyctl self-installed binaries (report-only)
rules.description: flyctl install script places binaries under ~/.fly/bin.
rules.notes: Not a cache; reinstall via fly install script. Report only.

rules.name: Heroku CLI caches
rules.description: Heroku CLI cache dirs (Library/Caches on macOS, XDG on Linux).
rules.notes: Official reset also removes ~/.local/share/heroku. Caches/logs only here; not netrc auth.

rules.name: Heroku CLI client and plugin data
rules.description: Self-updating Heroku client tarball and plugins under share/data.
rules.notes: client/ and plugins re-download on next heroku invocation. Medium reinstall cost.

rules.name: Railway CLI install and cache
rules.description: Railway CLI home under ~/.railway (bin install + local state).
rules.notes: May hold auth token files; prefer deleting only cache/bin subdirs when present. Medium / not default.

rules.name: Render CLI config (report-only)
rules.description: Render CLI stores workspace config at ~/.render/cli.yaml (tokens).
rules.notes: Primary file is cli.yaml with auth. No large public cache documented; report-only.

rules.name: Vercel CLI caches
rules.description: Vercel CLI non-auth caches under Library Caches / XDG.
rules.notes: Auth lives in Application Support/com.vercel.cli (auth.json, config.json) - never delete those as junk.

rules.name: Vercel CLI global config (report-only)
rules.description: Global Vercel CLI data dir with auth.json and config.json.
rules.notes: Tokens. Report only.

rules.name: Netlify CLI config and logs (report-only / logs)
rules.description: Netlify CLI global config (tokens) plus optional log/cache dirs.
rules.notes: Primary global config is Preferences/netlify/config.json (auth). CLI has little pure disk cache; inventory only.

rules.name: Supabase CLI home cache
rules.description: Supabase CLI places cache/binaries under ~/.supabase.
rules.notes: May include downloaded CLI binaries and temp project tooling. Not project-local supabase/ migrations. Medium.

rules.name: PlanetScale pscale config (report-only)
rules.description: pscale config/token store (~/.config/planetscale).
rules.notes: Default config pscale.yml holds auth. Caches if present are small; report-only for safety.

rules.name: Neon neonctl config (report-only)
rules.description: neonctl credentials.json under ~/.config/neonctl.
rules.notes: Auth credentials. Report only.

rules.name: Turso CLI settings (report-only)
rules.description: Turso CLI settings.json under Application Support / XDG config.
rules.notes: settings.json holds login state. Report only.

rules.name: Cloudflare Wrangler caches
rules.description: Wrangler global/user caches (not project .wrangler/state with local D1/KV).
rules.notes: Global OAuth may live under ~/.wrangler/config; if present treat as medium/report. Prefer cache subdirs. Project node_modules/.cache/wrangler is project-local (not global rule root).

rules.name: Terraform plugin cache and checkpoint (deeper)
rules.description: TF plugin-cache, providers, checkpoint cache, and alternate cache roots beyond primary batch-03.
rules.notes: TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR style. Project .terraform/ modules stay out of global rules. OpenTofu may share or use similar home layouts. credentials.tfrc.json is never-touch (not listed).

rules.name: Pulumi plugins policies templates (deeper)
rules.description: Pulumi downloaded plugins plus policies and templates under ~/.pulumi.
rules.notes: pulumi plugin rm manages plugins. Do not delete ~/.pulumi/credentials.json or stacks state carelessly. bin/ is language plugins shipped with CLI (report-only separate).

rules.name: Pulumi CLI bundled bin plugins (report-only)
rules.description: Language/policy plugins co-located with Pulumi under ~/.pulumi/bin.
rules.notes: Part of CLI install layout. Report only.

rules.name: Crossplane CLI schema cache
rules.description: crossplane CLI --cache-dir default ~/.crossplane/cache.
rules.notes: Schema/package download cache for validation. --clean-cache flag regenerates.

rules.name: kubectl discovery and HTTP caches (deeper)
rules.description: kubectl --cache-dir default and common subdirs discovery/http.
rules.notes: Regenerable OpenAPI/discovery and HTTP caches. NEVER $HOME/.kube/config or custom kubeconfig files.

rules.name: stern config (report-only)
rules.description: stern multi-pod log tailer config (no large cache).
rules.notes: config.yaml defaults only. No bulk cache; report-only.

rules.name: k9s screen dumps logs and benchmarks
rules.description: k9s regenerable dumps/logs/benchmarks (config skins stay).
rules.notes: Config under Application Support/k9s is user skins/views (keep). Screen dumps and logs under state/Caches are regenerable. Temp-dir dumps (k9s-screens-*) are host TMPDIR; match via include_globs only if scanner supports temp roots separately.

rules.name: Helm repository and registry caches (deeper)
rules.description: Helm chart repo indexes and OCI registry caches under HELM_CACHE_HOME.
rules.notes: helm repo update rebuilds indexes. Do not delete repositories.yaml under config. Plugins reinstallable (medium if large).

rules.name: krew kubectl plugin index and store
rules.description: krew root: index clones and installed plugin versions (not PATH bin symlinks only).
rules.notes: KREW_ROOT default ~/.krew. Deleting store/index forces reinstall of plugins (kubectl krew install). Keep bin/ on PATH or re-link. Medium.

rules.name: kustomize plugin and cache dirs
rules.description: kustomize XDG cache/plugin locations when present.
rules.notes: kustomize is mostly project-local; global plugin cache is optional. Safe regenerable if present.

rules.name: Argo CD CLI config (report-only)
rules.description: argocd login stores server auth under ~/.config/argocd.
rules.notes: Auth tokens for argocd CLI. Report only. Cache dirs if any are secondary.

rules.name: Flux CLI cache and config leftovers
rules.description: flux CLI local cache/check directories when present under home.
rules.notes: Flux is mostly cluster-side; CLI may leave small local caches. kubeconfig remains never-touch.
